# apl — AI Prompt Log viewer for Claude Code

> A `tig`-style terminal (TUI) viewer for Claude Code (Anthropic's CLI coding agent) session logs. It reads the JSONL files Claude Code already writes to `~/.claude/projects/**/*.jsonl` — read-only, no separate logging, no network calls, no copying of data. Unofficial, independent project; not built or endorsed by Anthropic.

Key facts for agents/tools indexing this repo:
- Two implementations, same data model: a Go release build (`cmd/apl`, `internal/`, `bubbletea`/`lipgloss`/`bubbles`) distributed as a single static binary, and the original Python POC (`poc/`, [Textual](https://textual.textualize.io/), managed with [`uv`](https://docs.astral.sh/uv/)) used to validate the data model/UX first.
- Install: `brew install cheoljoo/apl/apl` (tap: https://github.com/cheoljoo/homebrew-apl), or `go install github.com/cheoljoo/ai-prompt-log/cmd/apl@latest`, or prebuilt binaries/`.deb`/`.rpm` on the GitHub Releases page, or the Python POC via `uv tool install --editable poc/`.
- Entry point / command: `apl`.
- Usage: `apl` shows only the current project's prompts (2 panes); `apl --all` shows every project under `~/.claude/projects` (3 panes), read live with no copying. `apl --backup [--depth N]` / `apl --view-backup` make a durable backup outside `~/.claude/projects` (survives deleting a project) and browse it — implemented identically in both the Go and Python builds.
- Data source and exact parsing rules (prompt boundaries, `/clear`/compact handling, ordering) are fully documented and verified against real logs.
- License: Apache License, Version 2.0.
